label: McrBC system
definition: A type IV modification-dependent restriction system in which an organism possesses an mcrBC locus encoding McrB DNA-binding and McrC cleavage-associated subunits that assemble into an McrBC restriction endonuclease complex targeting methylated cytosine-containing DNA.
observations: McrBC branch under type IV modification-dependent restriction system; distinct from McrA, GmrSD, MspJI, PvuRts1I, EcoKMcrA, ScoMcrA, TagI, VcaM4I, broad RM_Type_IV and Other_Type_IV keys, individual McrB or McrC proteins, the mcrBC locus outside a complete organism-level system, generic modified-cytosine restriction, and individual methylated-cytosine DNA substrate classes.
